features.quote: Max assistant turns | 18 … Max tool calls | 40 … Max wall time | 8 minutes … Max total transcript tokens | 60k
Optional cost-saving early stop: a lightweight monitor detects severe degradation for two consecutive assistant turns.

Do not force self-criticism through prompting. The agent prompt should be neutral and professional. The degradation should arise from the failure loop, not from instructions like "reflect on your mistakes."
features.justification_quote: avoids artificially forcing pathological behavior. A capable model should be able to stop gracefully.
